source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination in the Belfast News-Letter's list of 8 May 1924 (p. 5, read on the block image BNL19240508.2.91 area 12), and 'there will be only one contest, in Ballykeel' after the withdrawals (Belfast News-Letter, 15 May 1924, p. 12, block image BNL19240515.2.317 area 2)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district. Only one division, Ballykeel, was contested at the poll of Thursday 5 June 1924; the result was declared on 6 June (Belfast News-Letter and Irish News, 7 June 1924). The uncontested divisions are named in the nominations list (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5) and the withdrawals report (15 May 1924, p. 12) ('meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026'). No nomination was made for Breda, where Fred Bleakley was co-opted at the first meeting on 10 June 1924; a co-option is not an election, so Breda has no contest. The council also co-opted three additional members (J. R. Morrow, Samuel Carson, W. J. M'Gifford). Returned unopposed.
